sources.title: Wikipedia: Pope John XXIII
sources.description: Head of the Catholic Church from 1958 to 1963

notes.text: Pope John XXIII was head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of Vatican City from 28 October 1958 until his death on 3 June 1963.
Pope John XXIII is remembered as a religious figure connected with Italy.
Pope John XXIII's recorded life dates place this profile around 1881-1963.
Pope John XXIII is grouped with Philosophy, Ethics & Religion in the People Library.
Pope John XXIII's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Italy historical setting.
